title: Quick Homemade Tomato Ketchup
summary: Tomato purée, vinegar, sugar and gentle spices simmered until thick, then sieved smooth.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Whisk
steps.text: Whisk all the ingredients together in the saucepan until no lumps of purée remain.

steps.title: Reduce
steps.text: Bring to a gentle simmer over medium-low heat and cook about 10 min, stirring and scraping the base, until thick and reduced to roughly 250 ml.

steps.title: Sieve
steps.text: Press the ketchup through a fine sieve into a bowl for a silky texture.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Cool completely, then spoon into a clean jar.

tips: Stir often near the end; thick ketchup catches easily.
It thickens more as it cools.
For a spicy version, add a pinch of cayenne.
storage: Keep in a clean, covered jar in the fridge for up to 2 weeks. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
